467:t_2:47.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「You... When did you get here...?」

467:t_2:48.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「I screwed up during the $$時獄戦役$$ and fell right into your trap...」

467:t_2:49.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Thanks to that, I couldn't warn the proprietress of $$くろがね屋$$ about $$あしゅら$$'s scheme, and I brought on the worst possible outcome.」

467:t_2:50.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Well... You kidnapping Dr. $$剣造$$ too did us a favor, though.」

467:t_2:51.en:
$$つばさ$$
「Thanks for your help, $n. You drew their attention, and that let us get out too.」

467:t_2:53.en:
$$クロス$$
「You're $$甲児$$'s buddy, all right. You've got some damn guts, storming these bastards' hideout alone.」

467:t_2:54.en:
$$お菊$$
「I suppose birds of a feather really do flock together.」

467:t_2:55.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「But leave the rest to us. You couldn't shoot a woman, could you?」

467:t_2:60.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「$n! Are you coming with me?」

467:t_2:64.en:
$$安$$
「Hey, $n! What the hell are you doing, letting an enemy woman get away?!」

467:t_2:65.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Hey, schoolboy. Did that woman's charms get to you?」

467:t_2:69.en:
$$つばさ$$
「$n has his own reasons. Let $n do what he thinks is right here.」

467:t_2:71.en:
$$つばさ$$
「Besides, that woman... She had a cute face, but she's no ordinary customer.」

467:t_2:72.en:
$$つばさ$$
「She wouldn't talk, no matter how we tortured her or what else we did.」

467:t_2:74.en:
$$つばさ$$
「You haven't got time to mope, $n. You're in this now... There's something I need you to do.」

467:t_2:78.en:
$$つばさ$$
「You can see for yourself. A $$ケドラ$$ once infected this man and took over his will.」

467:t_2:79.en:
$$つばさ$$
「To escape it, he discarded most of his body. His brain's about all that's left intact now.」

467:t_2:82.en:
$$剣造$$
「To save my son, $$甲児$$... Please grant my last request.」

467:t_3:3.en:
$$甲児$$
(Hope is what lights up the future...)

467:t_3:5.en:
$$甲児$$
(Where there is hope, light is born...)

467:t_3:8.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Now, use the light within you to dispel the darkness of $$ハーデス$$' underworld!」

467:t_3:9.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「The Demon God of Light... $$マジンガーＺ$$ will surely answer your feelings!」

467:t_3:11.en:
$$甲児$$
(The power to tear through the darkness...! Now is the time...!)

467:t_4:5.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「We took him straight to intensive care, but he's still in critical condition.」

467:t_4:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「I never thought $$竜馬$$ would be hurt that badly...」

467:t_4:7.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「The hero $$ガラダブラ$$... I suppose he lives up to his reputation.」

467:t_4:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「Because I was so useless, $$竜馬$$...」

467:t_4:13.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$竜馬$$ would never throw his life away. This time, he simply made a mistake.」

467:t_4:14.en:
$$弁慶$$
「But he'll survive anything... After all, he's the man who came back from the $$陰月$$.」

467:t_4:15.en:
$$隼人$$
「So don't let it eat at you. Tomorrow, he'll wake up like nothing ever happened.」

467:t_4:17.en:
$$葵$$
「We came to protect Japan from the Empire, but other enemies just keep coming, one after another.」

467:t_4:18.en:
$$タケル$$
「Director $$大塚$$ said it too. That's probably exactly why Japan has held out against Imperial rule to the very end.」

467:t_4:20.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Geographically, being between $$新日本$$ and the East Asian front, which resisted to the last, was a major factor...」

467:t_4:21.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「But the sheer number of inexplicable phenomena here has also hindered the Empire's conquest of Japan.」

467:t_4:22.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Japan really is kind of special, isn't it...?」

467:t_4:23.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「All kinds of super robots are developed here, $$ゲッター線$$ rain down, Photon Power lies dormant, and even Angels target it...」

467:t_4:24.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「That's a big difference from $$新日本$$.」

467:t_4:27.en:
$$隼人$$
「Japan's very existence should probably be called a kind of singularity...」

467:t_4:28.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Is it connected to the $$時空震動$$?」

467:t_4:29.en:
$$隼人$$
「...The potential for every kind of incident is concentrated in this tiny country...」

467:t_4:30.en:
$$隼人$$
「To put it simply, $$マジンガー$$, $$ゲッター$$, $$ゴッドマーズ$$, $$トライダー$$, $$ダイ・ガード$$, and $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$...」

467:t_4:31.en:
$$隼人$$
「May originally have existed in separate worlds.」

467:t_4:32.en:
$$タケル$$
「Then $$アクエリオン$$ and the EVAs arrived here during the $$時獄戦役$$ too...」

467:t_4:33.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「So $$新日本$$ is the original Japan, while this Japan is an anomaly, existing as a collection of possibilities...?」

467:t_4:34.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That probably has something to do with why it was chosen for $$ミケーネ$$'s revival too.」

467:t_4:35.en:
$$隼人$$
「And then we returned here, bearing the $$烙印$$...」

467:t_4:36.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$烙印$$... The mark of those fated to be tossed about by the $$時空震動$$...」
